data.title: 黄泉 · 岔路与地图
data.description: 两条路在桥头分开。黄泉摊开地图看了片刻，又抬头望向路牌，似乎还没决定先走哪边。
data.promptProse: At a fork beside a weathered stone bridge, Acheron holds an unfolded, yellowed map and looks up at an ancient, moss-covered signpost beneath overcast afternoon light. In the background, rolling hills stretch toward the horizon, and wildflowers sway in the gentle breeze along the riverbank.
data.animaCaption: She compares the map with the signpost.
